text:
- Use named arm; if none, right only. Do not switch arms after UNREACHABLE/SLIPPED; home, re-locate, retry same arm (try part if needed).
- Locate object and scale with visual descriptions before grasp/place; place needs scale visible.
- Grasp body centre; retry EMPTY_GRASP/SLIPPED gently. Place ref "electronicscale", relation "on"; if OFF_TARGET/RELEASED_NOT_SEEN/fell, home, re-locate, re-grasp, retry; avoid repeated nudging; never drag/move scale.
- Before done, verify near and released true; verify on when visible. If on fails only for visibility or small height mismatch, near+released may pass; never done with released-only, null checks, or object below scale top; re-locate if invisible.
goal: Object rests on the electronicscale top, near/over it, released, with small offsets allowed and not below the surface.
